core_identity_review: No additional blocker found in distinct v1 HU200 game/key, resume, export, accumulator audit, inference, registry or mismatch rejection; HU20/HU100/released regression fixtures pass.

findings.detail: Sampled RSS >=3 GiB is acted on only when train=True. A non-training command that samples 3.5 GiB returns complete with soft_stop_requested=False and failed=False. A kernel-proven 3.5 GiB export sets kernel_soft_limit_exceeded=True but the controller tests only the training receipt, allowing the 20M and 100M training endpoints and smoke after that export. This violates the fixed 3 GiB entire-family soft limit and terminal science-off rule; the native training fixes do not cover tool-stage breaches.
findings.requested_resolution: Record sampled and kernel soft breaches for all science operations and enforce a terminal no-new-training/no-smoke decision after required preservation/export/audit. Keep archive admission under the original fixed baseline, deadline and host guards. Add a controller regression with an export or audit soft peak, not only a training soft peak.
findings.title: Soft RSS breaches in export/audit do not latch subsequent science off

findings.detail: canonical() is json.dumps without a dataclass encoder. Hand.events contains HandStarted and other frozen event dataclasses; canonical(replay.events) raises TypeError before the first raw hand is written or smoke.json is produced. A synthetic audited HU200 average reproduces the failure without any training. The run controller preserves it as a partial and still attempts archive, but this optional authorized check cannot complete.
findings.requested_resolution: Compare deterministic event objects directly or serialize each event with the established event/dataclass representation before canonicalization. Add an actual smoke-worker fixture; keep the smoke optional and do not call the patched diagnostic a validation of unmodified source.
findings.title: Optional smoke always fails on its first event replay comparison

verification.stage: first completed hand, event/settlement replay comparison
verification.unmodified_smoke: TypeError: Object of type HandStarted is not JSON serializable

limitations: No real M1 pilot/admission, host guard exercise, process ownership change, training campaign, model research retrieval/archive/upload, live Slumbot call, paid compute, commit, release, merge or external comment.

The named existing tests include bounded deterministic trainer fixtures; these were run only as correctness tests. Additional mock reproductions spawned no real research workers and took no machine research lock.

Used existing native binaries; no rebuild or source-to-binary attestation. The release binary matches round1 SHA256 and native source is unchanged since round1. The preferred debug executable was absent, so Python preparation tests used their documented release fallback.

The 1000-hand retained parity fixture was rechecked with native parity. Round1 external Slumbot prefix replay across those 7432 decisions was not rerun; this review reran the external adapter unit fixtures instead.

Deadline/save/tool forecasts and archive admission reviewed in source and mocked fixtures; actual 60-minute feasibility, sampled family peaks/gaps, destination free space and archive/cloud acceptance remain unmeasured.
The optional smoke failed on unmodified source. A separate 320-hand run with an in-memory event serialization bypass exposed no further smoke failure but does not clear the P2 on exact source.
No full project test suite or CI approval claimed. All source and tracked files were left unchanged; this ignored JSON receipt is the only retained review write.
recommendation: Do not start dependent HU200 pilot training until P1 non-training soft-limit handling is fixed and independently reviewed on a new exact source. Fix the P2 before exercising the optional smoke, or explicitly omit that optional check.

round1_disposition.evidence: Controller tests cover train/export/audit/archive order without smoke after terminal native stop. Remaining non-training soft gap is a separate P1 above.
round1_disposition.title: Training exit3/soft stop still allowed optional smoke

round1_disposition.evidence: Archive is admitted at 599 seconds even with failed=True under fresh unchanged host guards; archive errors/None are recorded by fixed closeout finally. Original baseline/deadline is retained.
round1_disposition.title: Archive reserve, failure-latch and exception closeout

round1_disposition.evidence: Mocked 5 GiB kernel command peak produces failed receipt and latches failure before returning; no subsequent science is admitted.
round1_disposition.title: Kernel hard peak not enforced
